translations./garage/brief: The same corridor and forklift, with only LiDAR changed. Range doubles while refresh rate falls to one quarter; observe what changes.
translations./prediction/hint: Record a prediction. It does not affect the score; the run will give you evidence to test it.
translations./prediction/choices/0/feedback: Incorrect. With 12 m range at 5 Hz, the default build hits a forklift near (17.7, 6.1). Range only adds look-ahead distance.
translations./prediction/choices/1/feedback: Correct. At 5 m and 20 Hz, fresh measurements time the opening accurately. The recommended build earns every badge in 91.72 s.
translations./prediction/choices/2/text: Range and refresh rate both matter
translations./prediction/choices/2/feedback: Both matter, but this mission shows that range cannot rescue stale measurements. Preserve refresh rate first, then add range.
translations./running/normal_line: RO-1: Navigation stable. Approaching the signal tower.
translations./running/detected_line: RO-1: Forklift tracked. Predicting its path.
translations./debrief/success_summary: Observe more often, drive more precisely, and RO-1 still delivers.
translations./debrief/failure_summary: Select evidence on the right to jump the field view to that moment.
